name: Stoning
overview: Scripture presents stoning as a divinely ordained form of capital punishment for serious offenses, including rebellion against God and moral transgressions. The sample verses demonstrate that those who violate God's commands, such as the Sabbath breaker or those who lead others astray, are to be stoned until death, reflecting God's holiness and justice (Exodus 19:13; Deuteronomy 13:10; 17:5). The congregation's role in carrying out this judgment, as in the case of the man stoned outside the camp, underscores communal responsibility to uphold God's law (Numbers 15:36). This severe measure highlights the gravity of sin and the call to obedience within the covenant community.
